record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose this. A user who is reading an older phase should not be moved by a refresh, and a user who never picks anything should see each new phase as it starts.

## Counter-argument

Always jumping is simpler to explain and test, and the dashboard is mostly a glance at what is running now.

payload.alternatives: always jump to the current phase when it changes; never move a selection once made
payload.choice: The selection follows the current phase until the user selects another; it then stays pinned. Selecting the current phase again resumes following

record.subject: selection-follow
